page: Amazon Web Services c6i.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System and 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors (Ice Lake 8375C). Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 96 dedicated vCPUs derived from 48 physical cores with two threads per core running at an all-core turbo frequency of up to 3.5 GHz. The processor subsystem includes 54 MB of shared L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 with Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI), AES-NI, and VAES hardware encryption.

The system is equipped with 192 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, maintaining a 2:1 memory-to-core ratio typical of compute-intensive configurations. Memory throughput tests show large-block uncached read speeds reaching 320.22 GB/sec and small-block cached read speeds exceeding 4970 GB/sec. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached Amazon EBS storage for persistent file systems, while baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 38 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data reflects strong parallel execution and cryptographic performance across multi-threaded tests. The instance achieves a top-tier PassMark encryption score of 86799.68 and a multi-core score of 75255.86, alongside a stress-ng multi-core measurement of 92898.99. In practical software application workloads, it registers 85.93 million Redis SET operations per second, 64.58 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, and high-throughput Clang software compilation. However, single-core metrics fall into middle-tier bands, indicating the instance favors horizontally scalable, parallel tasks over pure single-thread speed.

The c6i.24xlarge instance offers balanced operational efficiency for workloads needing high compute density without the memory overhead of general-purpose tiers. It is well matched for clustered compute workloads, batch processing, CI/CD compilation pipelines, distributed caching layers, web fleet aggregation, and media transcoding pipelines.
